typical_laying_lengths.notes: Straight joints come in 20' or 40' lengths. Small diameters (up to 4" or 6") can be shipped on continuous coils up to 500–1,000 feet.
This is the universal retail and wholesale standard. 10-foot lengths are often sold at home improvement stores for easier transport.
Standard utility lengths feature an integrated bell-and-spigot gasketed joint.
Due to extreme weight, standard sections are 8 feet long. 7.5-foot or 12-foot joints are occasionally available from regional casting plants.
Most modern utility water mains are supplied in standard 20-foot nominal laying lengths.
Sold as Single Random Lengths (SRL, roughly 18-22 ft) or Double Random Lengths (DRL, roughly 38-42 ft) for cross-country pipelines.
